description: Read only what changed in a window you choose: the entities touched in it, as they are now, and the names deleted in it. Use it instead of read_graph when you are coming back to a memory you already know — the whole graph for two changed entities costs the context you came to use. The window reaches five minutes further back than you ask, so a change written by a peer with a slightly lagging clock is not lost, and reading the same window twice is harmless. It also returns until, the moment it stopped at, in this node's clock: pass that back as since and the next read continues from there.

limit.description: The most entities to return; omit for all of them

offset.description: How many entities to skip before the page; omit for none

since.description: The ISO-8601 moment to read after; omit it for the last five minutes, or pass the moment a previous call returned to continue where that call stopped

name: read_changes

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

title: Read Changes
